module: Flowgraph node 'Flow Interval' (logic category, file rateLimit). Lets a flow impulse through at regular intervals as long as the input flow is active. 'input' is a frequency (Hz) or, if asDuration is true, a duration (s); 'reverseHit' decides whether the impulse falls at the end or start of the cycle. Optional dt, otherwise mgr.dtSim.
notes: legacyPins renames fps and interval to 'frequency', a pin that does not exist in the schema (the pin is called 'input').
fps = |input|: a value of 0 would cause a division by zero (1/fps) in frequency mode.
work crashes if input is nil (math.abs(nil)).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

_executionStarted.desc: Resets time and prevFps to their initial value.

work.desc: Resets the timer on reset or when input changes; with flow, decrements time by dt; when time <= 0, adds 1/fps (or input in duration mode) and emits flow=true this frame, otherwise false.
